title: Kangxi radical positional variants: targeted alternative definitions and historical-origin audit

scope.scopeNote: Covers every form explicitly marked variant in radical-strokes.json, deduplicating its duplicate 艹. Not a claim to cover every historical glyph or every hidden Unicode symbol alias.
scope.explanationOfRecordCounts: 280 form records in radical-families-source.json are not 280 variants; radical-strokes.json has 65 records explicitly marked variant, of which 艹 is recorded twice; resulting audit covers 64 unique radical/variant pairs.

interpretationPolicy: Alternative dictionary definition is distinct from historical pictographic interpretation.
Historical origin of a parent radical is not a new lexical meaning of its variant.
A shared shape does not prove the same etymology in every containing character.
An entry without sourced claims remains unverified: it is NOT asserted to have no alternative meanings.
Character-specific tails/feet/feathers must not be assigned to 灬 generally.
Source citations support individual claims; no automatic redistribution of source text or images is authorized.

For radical #96, treat 王-shaped jade component (⺩) as 玉-derived in component context, while preserving 王 (wáng, king) as an independent lexical character; glyph resemblance alone is not etymological proof.

uiPresentationGuidance.whenSelectedAsRadicalVariant: Show jade-component identity and meaning from 玉 (yù), and optionally explain the look-alike independent character 王 (wáng).
uiPresentationGuidance.doNotOverwriteCharacterEntry: 王 (wáng) retains its ordinary dictionary meaning and reading in the Characters view.
uiPresentationGuidance.doNotRewriteSourceGlyph: Keep the recorded form 王 and alias ⺩ unchanged to preserve source mappings.
uiPresentationGuidance.exampleCurationNote: Prefer unambiguous jade-component examples such as 珠 (zhū) over 玉 (yù) itself in a form-specific “In a character” list; do not alter automated corpus results without checking their decomposition provenance.

componentNameTranslationPolicy.scope: Every one of the 64 distinct variant records has an English display name. Chinese conventional names with pinyin and English translation are supplied only where represented in the cited component name lists.

componentNameTranslationPolicy.warning: Do not synthesize Chinese component names from these English labels. Keep dictionary readings, component names, graphic descriptions and etymological claims separate.
